definitions.explanation: A designated place where buses pick up and drop off passengers.

examples.english: To wait at the bus stop.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}のバス{停|てい}で{降|お}りる。
examples.english: To get off at the next bus stop.

examples.japanese: バス{停|てい}は{駅|えき}の{前|まえ}にある。
examples.english: The bus stop is in front of the station.

notes:
A contraction of バス{停留所|ていりゅうじょ} (bus stop — full formal term). バス{停|てい} is the standard everyday form.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- バス{停|てい}で{待|ま}つ: to wait at the bus stop
- バス{停|てい}で{降|お}りる: to get off at the bus stop
- {次|つぎ}のバス{停|てい}: the next bus stop
- {最寄|もよ}りのバス{停|てい}: the nearest bus stop

RELATED TERMS:
- {停留所|ていりゅうじょ}: bus stop (formal, used on maps and official signs)
- バス{乗|の}り{場|ば}: bus boarding area (at larger stations or terminals)
- バスターミナル: bus terminal

In Japanese cities, bus stops typically display route maps, timetables, and the stop name. The formal name {停留所|ていりゅうじょ} appears on official signs, but people say バス{停|てい} in conversation.
